All three scenarios start revenue growth below last year's {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, the three-year compound of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct} and the five-year compound of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}. most_sensitive.assumption: Revenue growth in year one, faded in a straight line to the terminal rate
most_sensitive.reading: Not read off a grid. The sensitivity grid was not computed, for the reason printed under valuation.missing, and there is no spread in value across scenarios to read. What the drivers do show is where the three scenarios differ most from each other against the record. Python fades growth in a straight line, so the year-one rate also sets growth through the middle of the decade and governs how large revenue becomes before the terminal value. The bear case starts far below every filled year. The base case starts below fiscal 2023's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.revenue_growth|pct}, the slowest filled year. The bull case starts close to fiscal 2025's {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.revenue_growth|pct}. All three sit below the three-year compound of {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}. The grid would have measured how far value moves across that spread. It is not measured here.

most_sensitive.assumption: Reinvestment rate in year one, together with the operating margin it applies to
most_sensitive.reading: Also not read off a grid, for the same reason. In all three scenarios year one reinvests more than after-tax operating income, so free cash flow to the firm starts negative by construction, and value rests on later years and the terminal value. That choice follows the record. In fiscal 2026 trade working capital rose by {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital}, and free cash flow to the firm was {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm} on operating income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_income}. Fiscal 2024 also absorbed cash, with simple free cash flow of {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.free_cash_flow_simple}, while fiscal 2025 released {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.free_cash_flow_simple}. The margin the rate applies to is thin: a fiscal 2026 gross margin of {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct} and an operating margin of {ratios.profitability.operating_margin|pct}. That keeps after-tax income small beside the inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} and the purchase commitments of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} it must carry. The discount rate, which a grid usually varies, does not exist here because the beta is missing.

accounting_adjustments.reading: There were none, and none could have moved value, because no valuation was run. The accounting reader wrote no adjustment. Its adjustments list is empty, and it says: "No calculator field carries the shortfall in any reserve or the change in the write-down, so no earnings adjustment is written." The quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} deducts only share-based compensation of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}, with no adjustment applied or refused. The accounting reader flagged several items: thinning credit, warranty and inventory reserves; purchase commitments of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} whose loss provision is no longer quantified; and an inventory line that fails to articulate by {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}. These enter only the bear case's year-one margin and reinvestment, as stated assumptions rather than measured adjustments. The largest bridge item is not an accounting adjustment but a mapping gap: the calculator's total debt of {ratios.solvency.total_debt} leaves out the bank debt and convertible notes that the earnings release states.

summary_ko.value_range: 베타와 기준일 주가가 없어 할인율(WACC)을 계산하지 못했고, 그래서 가치 범위와 시나리오별 기업가치·주당가치도 나오지 않았습니다. 읽을 수 있는 것은 가정과 과거 기록의 비교뿐이며, 세 시나리오 모두 첫해 매출 성장률을 지난해 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}와 삼 년 복리 성장률 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_three_year_compound|pct}보다 낮게 잡았습니다.
summary_ko.price_position: 계산기에 기준일 주가가 없어 주가가 가치 범위의 어디쯤에 있는지 읽을 수 없습니다. 기업 기준 잉여현금흐름도 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm}으로 마이너스여서, 현금흐름 수익률로 교차 확인할 수도 없습니다.
summary_ko.market_implied_growth: 역DCF를 계산하지 못해 주가가 전제하는 성장률은 알 수 없습니다. 비교 기준이 될 회사 기록은 지난해 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, 오 년 복리 {earnings_versus_cash.history.revenue_growth_five_year_compound|pct}이고, 회사는 다음 분기 매출을 방금 끝난 분기의 {ratios.growth.revenue.this_quarter}보다 훨씬 높게 제시했습니다.
summary_ko.most_sensitive: 민감도 표를 계산하지 못해 가치가 가장 민감하게 반응하는 두 가정을 표에서 읽을 수는 없습니다. 시나리오끼리 가장 크게 갈리는 가정은 첫해 매출 성장률과 첫해 재투자율이며, 세 시나리오 모두 첫해 재투자가 세후 영업이익보다 커서 기업 잉여현금흐름이 마이너스로 출발합니다.
summary_ko.accounting_adjustments: 회계 분석에서 적용한 조정은 없고, 가치평가 자체가 돌지 않았으므로 조정이 가치를 움직이지도 않았습니다. 다만 계산기는 총차입금을 {ratios.solvency.total_debt}로 읽어 회사가 밝힌 은행 차입금과 전환사채를 빠뜨리고 있어, 나중에 가치평가를 돌릴 때 이 차입금을 빼지 않으면 주당가치가 부풀려집니다.
